cases.title: Create an account from a private window
preconditions: A private browser window is open
expected: It says "No envelopes yet" and shows "Upload new PDF"
The sender's email is shown at the top right

cases.title: Sign out and sign back in
steps: Check that the sign-in page is shown
expected: The Inbox opens with the same documents as before

cases.title: Wrong password and duplicate sign-up
steps: Type the sender's email into "Email" and any 8+ character password into "Password"
expected: The wrong password shows a plain error and stays on the sign-in page
Signing up again with the same email shows a plain error (the account already exists)

cases.title: Short password is refused
expected: A message says the password needs at least 8 characters
